selection.rule: simplest within 0.005 of best pooled LOCO Harrell C (head-to-head) and O/E in [0.9, 1.1]

cohort_flow: with follow-up > 0 (53 censored at day 0 removed)
blasts, Hb and platelets recorded  = INTENDED-USE COHORT
karyotype readable and ANC recorded = HEAD-TO-HEAD COHORT (IPSS-R computable)
